sources.label: NHHC · Scorpion IV, armed steam yacht and 1 July 1898 action

note: Equipment review: the anonymous illustration uses the light armed-steam-vessel family represented by Scorpion, the converted steam yacht that attacked Manzanillo with Osceola on 1 July 1898. It does not identify opposing camps or model the shore batteries, and is not an equipment assignment for the separate 30 June action.
